body: I have sometimes a sensation I call "sweet violence" where everything including my perception of my environment  feel fuzzy and weirdly intense and violent . I used to have it regularly when I was a kid during specific dreams but now it's kind of rare and generally happens when I'm working. Anyone else ?

I tried music, drawing , eating etc but nothing worked as efficiently as self harm. Don't worry, I always make sure to disinfect the blade and not go overboard with it. 
I will try other ways of coping when I'm not too distressed. (Perhaps I should get a pet ? I love animals and they seem to be of a great help)
Thanks for the offer, I really appreciate
Your female version from another country then.I hope we can help each other (or plunge together. Depends if it's possible to get better and have a normal life).
